KitchenProject.title: KitchenProject
KitchenProject.description: A bespoke 2D/3D kitchen layout project created by an authenticated user.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this kitchen project.

name.description: Title of the kitchen project (1 to 120 characters).

shape.description: Kitchen layout shape (L_SHAPE, U_SHAPE, ISLAND, GALLEY, SINGLE_WALL).

roomHeightCm.description: Room ceiling height in centimeters (200 to 450).

cabinetFinish.description: Selected cabinet front material and color finish.

wallColorHex.description: Hex color code for room walls.

itemsData.description: Compact pipe-delimited string encoding placed kitchen modules, coordinates, dimensions, rotation, and unit prices.

totalPriceSar.description: Calculated total Bill of Materials (BOM) price in SAR.

ergonomicScore.description: Calculated NKBA Work Triangle ergonomic score (0 to 100).

notes.description: Architectural notes or custom specifications for the kitchen project.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

QuoteRequest.title: QuoteRequest
QuoteRequest.description: A formal request for manufacturing quote and consultation sent to a certified kitchen showroom.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user submitting the quote request.

projectId.description: Document ID of the associated KitchenProject owned by the user.

projectName.description: Snapshot name of the kitchen project.

showroomName.description: Selected certified kitchen showroom or manufacturer name.

customerName.description: Full name of the customer requesting the quote.

preferredInstallWindow.description: Preferred timeline for kitchen manufacturing and installation.

specialNotes.description: Special site measurement or appliance integration notes.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the quote request.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the quote request was submitted (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the quote request was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

KitchenCatalogUnit.title: KitchenCatalogUnit
KitchenCatalogUnit.description: A modular kitchen unit (cabinet, countertop island, oven, refrigerator, dishwasher, or sink) stored in the Firestore catalog.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this catalog item.

code.description: 3D renderer module type code (SINK, STOVE, FRIDGE, DISHWASHER, BASE_DRAWERS, BASE_60, CORNER_BASE, WALL_GLASS, WALL_60, TALL_PANTRY, TALL_OVEN, ISLAND_MAIN).

nameAr.description: Arabic display title of the kitchen unit.

category.description: Unit category (BASE, WALL, TALL, ISLAND, APPLIANCE, SINK).

subType.description: Specific unit subtype (CABINET, COUNTERTOP, OVEN, FRIDGE, DISHWASHER, SINK, ISLAND).

elevationCm.description: Mounting elevation from floor in centimeters (0 to 220).

countertopIncluded.description: Whether this unit includes a countertop surface slab.

descriptionAr.description: Detailed specifications of the kitchen unit.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the catalog unit was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the catalog unit was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/kitchen_projects/{projectId}.description: Stores user-authored 2D/3D kitchen layout projects, materials, BOM prices, and ergonomic scores.

/quote_requests/{quoteId}.description: Stores showroom quote and manufacturing consultation requests linked to a user's kitchen project.

/kitchen_units_catalog/{unitId}.description: Stores the Firestore catalog of kitchen units (cabinets, countertops, islands, ovens, refrigerators, dishwashers, and sinks) for the authenticated user.
